description.narrative: Small Charities Challenge grants are for very small, UK-based development charities with an annual income of £250,000 or less. It offers project grants of up to £50,000 to deliver projects that alleviate extreme poverty and contribute to the achievement of the Global Goals. SCCF also invests in capacity development for small UK charities.
